name: ABS
what: Returns the absolute (positive) value of a number.

name: ACOS
what: Returns the angle, in radians, whose cosine is the number.

name: APPROX_COUNT_DISTINCT
what: Returns the approximate number of distinct non-NULL values, faster than COUNT(DISTINCT) on large tables.

name: APP_NAME
what: Returns the application name of the current session.

name: ASCII
what: Returns the ASCII code of the first character of a string.

name: ASIN
what: Returns the angle, in radians, whose sine is the number.

name: ATAN
what: Returns the angle, in radians, whose tangent is the number.

name: ATN2
what: Returns the angle, in radians, of the point (x, y).

name: AVG
what: Returns the average of the values in a group; NULLs are ignored.

name: BINARY_CHECKSUM
what: Returns a binary checksum over a row or a list of expressions, sensitive to case.

name: CAST
what: Converts an expression to another data type.

name: CEILING
what: Returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to the number.

name: CHAR
what: Returns the character with the given ASCII code: CHAR(13) is a carriage return.

name: CHARINDEX
what: Returns the position of the first occurrence of one string in another, or 0 when it is not found.

name: CHECKSUM
what: Returns a hash value computed over a row or a list of expressions.

name: CHECKSUM_AGG
what: Returns the checksum of the values in a group, to detect changes.

name: CHOOSE
what: Returns the item at the given 1-based index from a list of values.

name: COALESCE
what: Returns the first argument that is not NULL.

name: COLUMNPROPERTY
what: Returns a property of a column or parameter, such as 'IsIdentity' or 'AllowsNull'.

name: COL_LENGTH
what: Returns the defined length of a column, in bytes.

name: COL_NAME
what: Returns the name of a column from the table's id and the column's id.

name: COMPRESS
what: Compresses a value with GZIP.

name: CONCAT
what: Joins strings end to end; NULL arguments count as empty strings.

name: CONCAT_WS
what: Joins strings with a separator between them, skipping NULLs.

name: CONNECTIONPROPERTY
what: Returns a property of the current connection, such as 'client_net_address'.

name: CONTEXT_INFO
what: Returns the context_info value set with SET CONTEXT_INFO.

name: CONVERT
what: Converts an expression to another data type, with an optional style for dates and numbers.

name: COS
what: Returns the cosine of an angle in radians.

name: COT
what: Returns the cotangent of an angle in radians.

name: COUNT
what: Returns the number of rows (COUNT(*)) or of non-NULL values in a group.

name: COUNT_BIG
what: Like COUNT, but returns a bigint.

name: CUME_DIST
what: Returns the cumulative distribution of a row within its partition (0 to 1); used with OVER (ORDER BY ...).

name: CURRENT_REQUEST_ID
what: Returns the id of the current request.

name: CURRENT_TRANSACTION_ID
what: Returns the id of the current transaction.

name: CURSOR_STATUS
what: Returns whether a cursor is open, closed or not allocated.

name: DATABASEPROPERTYEX
what: Returns a property of a database, such as 'Status', 'Recovery' or 'Collation'.

name: DATALENGTH
what: Returns the number of bytes used to store a value.

name: DATEADD
what: Adds a number of datepart units (year, month, day, hour...) to a date.

name: DATEDIFF
what: Returns the number of datepart boundaries crossed between two dates.

name: DATEDIFF_BIG
what: Like DATEDIFF, but returns a bigint.

name: DATEFROMPARTS
what: Builds a date from a year, a month and a day.

name: DATENAME
what: Returns a datepart of a date as text (the month's or the weekday's name).

name: DATEPART
what: Returns a datepart of a date as an integer.

name: DATETIME2FROMPARTS
what: Builds a datetime2 from its parts.

name: DATETIMEFROMPARTS
what: Builds a datetime from its parts.

name: DATETRUNC
what: Truncates a date to the start of the given datepart (SQL Server 2022).

name: DATE_BUCKET
what: Returns the start of the fixed-size time bucket a date falls in (SQL Server 2022).

name: DAY
what: Returns the day of the month of a date.

name: DB_ID
what: Returns the id of a database, or of the current one.

name: DB_NAME
what: Returns the name of a database from its id, or of the current one.

name: DECOMPRESS
what: Decompresses a value compressed with COMPRESS (GZIP).

name: DEGREES
what: Converts an angle from radians to degrees.

name: DENSE_RANK
what: Ranks rows within their partition without gaps after ties.

name: DIFFERENCE
what: Compares the SOUNDEX codes of two strings: 0 (different) to 4 (alike).

name: EOMONTH
what: Returns the last day of the month of a date, optionally months later.

name: ERROR_LINE
what: In a CATCH block, returns the line number where the error occurred.

name: ERROR_MESSAGE
what: In a CATCH block, returns the error's message.

name: ERROR_NUMBER
what: In a CATCH block, returns the error's number.

name: ERROR_PROCEDURE
what: In a CATCH block, returns the procedure or trigger where the error occurred.

name: ERROR_SEVERITY
what: In a CATCH block, returns the error's severity.

name: ERROR_STATE
what: In a CATCH block, returns the error's state number.

name: EXP
what: Returns e raised to the power of the number.

name: FILEPROPERTY
what: Returns a property of a database file, such as 'SpaceUsed' (in 8 KB pages).

name: FILE_ID
what: Returns the id of a database file from its logical name.

name: FILE_NAME
what: Returns the logical name of a database file from its id.

name: FIRST_VALUE
what: Returns the first value in an ordered window.

name: FLOOR
what: Returns the largest integer less than or equal to the number.

name: FORMAT
what: Formats a value with a .NET format string and an optional culture (slow on many rows).

name: FORMATMESSAGE
what: Builds a message from a sys.messages entry or a printf-style string.

name: GENERATE_SERIES
what: Returns a column of numbers from start to stop (SQL Server 2022).

name: GETANSINULL
what: Returns the database's default nullability for new columns.

name: GETDATE
what: Returns the current date and time of the server (datetime).

name: GETUTCDATE
what: Returns the current UTC date and time (datetime).

name: GREATEST
what: Returns the largest value of a list (SQL Server 2022).

name: GROUPING
what: Returns 1 when a GROUP BY ROLLUP or CUBE row aggregates the column, else 0.

name: GROUPING_ID
what: Returns the level of grouping of a ROLLUP, CUBE or GROUPING SETS row as a bit mask.

name: HASHBYTES
what: Returns the hash of a value with an algorithm such as SHA2_256.

name: HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME
what: Returns 1 when the current user has a permission on a securable.

name: HOST_NAME
what: Returns the name of the client computer.

name: IDENT_CURRENT
what: Returns the last identity value generated for a table, in any session or scope.

name: IDENT_INCR
what: Returns the increment of a table's identity column.

name: IDENT_SEED
what: Returns the seed of a table's identity column.

name: IIF
what: Returns one of two values depending on a condition.

name: INDEXPROPERTY
what: Returns a property of an index or statistics, such as 'IsClustered'.

name: INDEX_COL
what: Returns the name of a column of an index key.

name: ISDATE
what: Returns 1 when a string is a valid date, else 0.

name: ISJSON
what: Returns 1 when a string is valid JSON, else 0.

name: ISNULL
what: Returns the replacement value when the expression is NULL.

name: ISNUMERIC
what: Returns 1 when a value can be converted to a numeric type, else 0.

name: IS_MEMBER
what: Returns 1 when the current user is a member of a Windows group or database role.

name: IS_ROLEMEMBER
what: Returns 1 when a principal is a member of a database role.

name: IS_SRVROLEMEMBER
what: Returns 1 when a login is a member of a server role, such as 'sysadmin'.

name: JSON_ARRAY
what: Builds a JSON array from values (SQL Server 2022).

name: JSON_MODIFY
what: Updates a value in a JSON string and returns the new JSON.

name: JSON_OBJECT
what: Builds a JSON object from key: value pairs (SQL Server 2022).

name: JSON_PATH_EXISTS
what: Returns 1 when a path exists in a JSON string (SQL Server 2022).

name: JSON_QUERY
what: Extracts an object or an array from a JSON string.

name: JSON_VALUE
what: Extracts a scalar value from a JSON string.

name: LAG
what: Returns a value from an earlier row of the window.

name: LAST_VALUE
what: Returns the last value in an ordered window frame.

name: LEAD
what: Returns a value from a later row of the window.

name: LEAST
what: Returns the smallest value of a list (SQL Server 2022).

name: LEFT
what: Returns the first characters of a string.

name: LEN
what: Returns the number of characters of a string, without trailing spaces.

name: LOG
what: Returns the natural logarithm of a number, or its logarithm in a given base.

name: LOG10
what: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.

name: LOWER
what: Returns a string in lower case.

name: LTRIM
what: Removes leading spaces (or the given characters, SQL Server 2022).

name: MAX
what: Returns the largest value in a group.

name: MIN
what: Returns the smallest value in a group.

name: MONTH
what: Returns the month of a date.

name: NCHAR
what: Returns the Unicode character with the given code.

name: NEWID
what: Returns a new uniqueidentifier.

name: NEWSEQUENTIALID
what: Returns a GUID greater than the last one made on this computer; only in a column's DEFAULT.

name: NTILE
what: Splits the ordered rows into the given number of groups and returns each row's group.

name: NULLIF
what: Returns NULL when both expressions are equal, else the first one.

name: OBJECTPROPERTY
what: Returns a property of an object, such as 'IsUserTable' or 'TableHasPrimaryKey'.

name: OBJECTPROPERTYEX
what: Like OBJECTPROPERTY, with more properties and values of other types.

name: OBJECT_DEFINITION
what: Returns the T-SQL text of a module: a procedure, view, function or trigger.

name: OBJECT_ID
what: Returns the id of a database object from its name, or NULL.

name: OBJECT_NAME
what: Returns the name of a database object from its id.

name: OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME
what: Returns the schema of a database object from its id.

name: OPENJSON
what: Reads a JSON string as rows and columns.

name: ORIGINAL_LOGIN
what: Returns the login that connected, even after EXECUTE AS.

name: PARSE
what: Converts a string to a date or number type, with an optional culture.

name: PATINDEX
what: Returns the position of the first match of a LIKE pattern in a string, or 0.

name: PERCENTILE_CONT
what: Returns the interpolated value at a percentile: WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x) OVER (...).

name: PERCENTILE_DISC
what: Returns the first value at or above a percentile: WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x) OVER (...).

name: PERCENT_RANK
what: Returns the relative rank of a row within its partition (0 to 1).

name: PI
what: Returns the constant pi.

name: POWER
what: Returns a number raised to a power.

name: QUOTENAME
what: Returns a name with delimiters ([name] by default), to build dynamic SQL safely.

name: RADIANS
what: Converts an angle from degrees to radians.

name: RAND
what: Returns a random number from 0 to 1; the same for every row of one query.

name: RANK
what: Ranks rows within their partition, with gaps after ties.

name: REPLACE
what: Replaces every occurrence of a string with another.

name: REPLICATE
what: Repeats a string a number of times.

name: REVERSE
what: Returns a string with its characters in reverse order.

name: RIGHT
what: Returns the last characters of a string.

name: ROUND
what: Rounds a number to the given precision, or truncates it.

name: ROWCOUNT_BIG
what: Returns the number of rows the last statement affected, as a bigint.

name: ROW_NUMBER
what: Numbers the rows of each partition from 1 in the given order.

name: RTRIM
what: Removes trailing spaces (or the given characters, SQL Server 2022).

name: SCHEMA_ID
what: Returns the id of a schema, or of the default one.

name: SCHEMA_NAME
what: Returns the name of a schema from its id, or the default schema's.

name: SCOPE_IDENTITY
what: Returns the last identity value inserted in the current scope.

name: SERVERPROPERTY
what: Returns a property of the server, such as 'ProductVersion', 'Edition' or 'MachineName'.

name: SESSION_CONTEXT
what: Returns a value stored with sp_set_session_context.

name: SIGN
what: Returns -1, 0 or 1 by the sign of a number.

name: SIN
what: Returns the sine of an angle in radians.

name: SOUNDEX
what: Returns a four-character code of how a string sounds in English.

name: SPACE
what: Returns a string of spaces.

name: SQRT
what: Returns the square root of a number.

name: SQUARE
what: Returns the square of a number.

name: STDEV
what: Returns the statistical standard deviation of the values in a group.

name: STDEVP
what: Returns the population standard deviation of the values in a group.

name: STR
what: Converts a number to text with a length and decimals.

name: STRING_AGG
what: Joins the values of a group into one string with a separator.

name: STRING_ESCAPE
what: Escapes special characters of a string for JSON.

name: STRING_SPLIT
what: Splits a string by a separator into rows (value, and ordinal with enable_ordinal).

name: STUFF
what: Deletes characters from a string and inserts others at that position.

name: SUBSTRING
what: Returns part of a string, from a start position (1-based) for a length.

name: SUM
what: Returns the total of the values in a group.

name: SUSER_ID
what: Returns the login identification number of a login.

name: SUSER_NAME
what: Returns the login name from its identification number, or the current one.

name: SUSER_SID
what: Returns the security identifier (SID) of a login.

name: SUSER_SNAME
what: Returns the login name from its SID, or the current login.

name: SWITCHOFFSET
what: Changes the time zone offset of a datetimeoffset.

name: SYSDATETIME
what: Returns the current date and time of the server (datetime2).

name: SYSDATETIMEOFFSET
what: Returns the current date and time with the server's time zone offset.

name: SYSUTCDATETIME
what: Returns the current UTC date and time (datetime2).

name: TAN
what: Returns the tangent of an angle in radians.

name: TIMEFROMPARTS
what: Builds a time from its parts.

name: TODATETIMEOFFSET
what: Gives a date a time zone offset.

name: TRANSLATE
what: Replaces each character of a list by the character at the same place of another.

name: TRIM
what: Removes leading and trailing spaces (or the given characters).

name: TRY_CAST
what: Like CAST, but returns NULL instead of an error when the conversion fails.

name: TRY_CONVERT
what: Like CONVERT, but returns NULL instead of an error when the conversion fails.

name: TRY_PARSE
what: Like PARSE, but returns NULL instead of an error when the conversion fails.

name: TYPEPROPERTY
what: Returns a property of a data type, such as 'Precision'.

name: TYPE_ID
what: Returns the id of a data type from its name.

name: TYPE_NAME
what: Returns the name of a data type from its id.

name: UNICODE
what: Returns the Unicode code of the first character of a string.

name: UPPER
what: Returns a string in upper case.

name: USER_ID
what: Returns the id of a database user, or the current one's.

name: USER_NAME
what: Returns the name of a database user from its id, or the current one's.

name: VAR
what: Returns the statistical variance of the values in a group.

name: VARP
what: Returns the population variance of the values in a group.

name: XACT_STATE
what: Returns 1 in a transaction that can commit, -1 in one that must roll back, 0 outside a transaction.

name: YEAR
what: Returns the year of a date.
